title: SmartResume AI: Automated ATS Feedback and Keyword Gap Analyzer
tagline: Turn PDF resumes into structured interview readiness scores with Gemini Flash
summary: Builds a web tool where a student uploads their resume PDF and a target job description. The AI finds missing skills and rewrites weak bullet points into clear achievements.
resumeBullet: Engineered an ATS resume optimization engine using Google Gemini API and Streamlit; extracted semantic discrepancies against JD keywords, boosting candidate match relevancy by 40%.

title: GitHub Repo AI Inspector: Code Explanation and Bug Spotter
tagline: Paste any public GitHub URL and get an interactive AI walkthrough of the codebase
summary: Fetches repository README and top source files via GitHub API, passes them through a prompt pipeline, and generates component breakdowns and detected edge cases.
resumeBullet: Developed a lightweight browser based codebase analyzer leveraging GitHub API and prompt chaining to produce instant system architecture summaries and edge case alerts.

title: Exam Proctor AI: Eye Gaze and Face Detection Assistant
tagline: Webcam based classroom assistant running fully in the browser
summary: Tracks student head pose, gaze direction, and face count directly on browser webcam feed to flag offscreen glances without sending heavy video feeds to the cloud.
resumeBullet: Built browser based proctoring system using MediaPipe FaceMesh to classify gaze deviation angles and multi person presence in under 45ms per frame.

title: Microgrid Pulse: Predictive Battery Health and Solar Forecaster
tagline: Forecast solar battery condition and storage efficiency using simulated sensor data
summary: Simulates voltage, temperature, and charging cycle curves from IoT nodes; uses regression and AI assistance to predict battery remaining useful life.
resumeBullet: Created predictive maintenance IoT dashboard modeling solar inverter sensor feeds; predicted battery degradation anomalies with 88% precision to prevent unscheduled outages.

title: SiliconDoc AI: Automated Circuit Diagram and Datasheet Assistant
tagline: Upload microcontroller datasheets and query pinouts in plain English
summary: Multimodal assistant that reads semiconductor datasheets, pinout charts, and schematic screenshots to answer hardware design queries and calculate resistor values.
resumeBullet: Built multimodal hardware documentation query bot utilizing Gemini Vision to extract microchip pin configurations and calculate passive component values directly from schematics.

title: WeldVision: AI Powered Industrial Surface Defect Detector
tagline: Classify porosity, cracks, and defects in metal joints from mobile photos
summary: Uses transfer learning on pretrained vision models to inspect manufacturing weld seams, assigning a pass or fail confidence score and generating a quality report.
resumeBullet: Trained and deployed a computer vision quality control pipeline categorizing weld seam defects with 91% accuracy, eliminating manual visual inspection delays.

title: BuildCode AI: IS 456 Structural Compliance Assistant
tagline: Prompt assistant that verifies beam dimensions and concrete grades against Indian Building Codes
summary: Input structural parameters like span, load, and concrete grade; the AI references IS 456 clauses and flags whether the minimum reinforcement criteria are satisfied.
resumeBullet: Created an interactive IS Code structural compliance validator powered by Gemini API, accelerating preliminary RCC beam verification and code citation lookups.

title: JobScout AI: Placement Job Assistant and Email Drafter
tagline: Watches target tech hiring boards and generates personalized outreach emails
summary: Parses technical requirements from job postings, compares them with student profiles, and drafts polite recruiter outreach messages.
resumeBullet: Engineered autonomous job assistant combining web scraping and LLM prompt templates to synthesize customized hiring manager outreach with an 85% relevance score.
